_publications._context: Human lymphoblastoid cell line derived from an individual with NF1 (blood, EBV-transformed with cyclosporin A per Anderson & Gusella 1984). Carries NF1 variant c.3104T>G, substitution in exon 23 (18) (p.M1035R), a missense substitution. Clinical data are available for this individual. Synapse syn74552629; James Walker's group, Massachusetts General Hospital.

basicInfo.description: Human lymphoblastoid cell line derived via EBV transformation from the blood of an individual with NF1, carrying the NF1 variant c.3104T>G (p.M1035R) (Substitution in exon 23 (18)).
